bio_en: Tigran Bztikian came from the Bztikian family of Adana. During the Adana massacre of 1909 he resisted the mob with exceptional courage and, rifle in hand until the last day, is credited with saving an important part of the city from destruction. He was one of the ARF's most dedicated activists in Cilicia. He died at the age of 28 in a Beirut hospital in 1910, after several months of illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Years 1882-1910 from the story title; death reported in Azatamart, 15 April 1910.
